note: The champion recipe every Short follows (CLAUDE.md, the weekly loop). The improver updates it whenever a challenger is kept: the rule it adds or replaces gets `since` and `from: "cycle <n>"`, and the cycle goes into `changes`. Shown on the dashboard's Growth loop page.

rules.text: One surprising true money fact about a real, named person or business, from sourced facts; never an invented example
The title and the hook's first sentence state it with the name and the figure (no "You think X?", no "Watch this")
Three openings drafted; a fresh reviewer picks the strongest
The payoff is the story's most surprising figure; no reaction shots
The cast act a skit only when they are in the story
One narrator for every Short, the voice at 1.4
Shot and build beats: the cast big, money as a thing, a camera that follows each action
